_comment: Template for evidence/<run-id>/evidence.json. Every value here is a placeholder: fill each from the run, never invent one. Stage 13 on 8453 is the basket unpauses only (issue 1520): one govern entry per basket (unpause-PROTO, unpause-AGENT, unpause-RWA), each with its own schedule tx, its own execute tx, its own timelock operation id (operation_id, optional), the receipt statuses and the block timestamps. All three are scheduled in one sitting and wait one delay: each execute timestamp is at least 172800 s after the same entry's schedule timestamp. No two entries share a transaction or an operation id. update-delay, batch and cancel are Twin-only and are rejected on 8453. Issue 1667: a vault that pause-all paused is reopened by a numbered Safe round; add an optional unpause-USDC entry (rmUSDC, one unpauseDeposits call) and, for a vault paused again, a further entry of the same step with round 2, 3 and so on (each scheduled after the previous round executed, with its own transactions and operation id). A post-launch consensus receipt release (issue 1611, never part of stage 13) goes in receipt_releases, one entry per receipt id, with consensus_receipt.address: one schedule and one execute at least 172800 s apart, target the receipt contract, calldata releaseReceipt(receipt_id). Leave receipt_releases empty when none was released. No secret goes in this file.
